title: Dianna Russini's Tom Brady/Titans reporting from 2020 comes under scrutiny

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dianna Russini's Tom Brady/Titans reporting from 2020 comes under scrutiny
sources.description: ESPN won't comment on whether it will be reviewing the reporting of former ESPN (and The Athletic) reporter Dianna Russini, given the photos published last week of Russini with Patriots coach Mike Vrabel in March 2020.
